messages:
sara: Heads up — seeing a short spike of 502s for tenant="cobalt" around 23:10 UTC. Can someone point me to the fastest dashboards / traces to grab samples so I can open a support ticket? cc @alex @tim :eyes:

alex: Quick paths — Grafana ingress errors dash: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/ingress-errors . Use the 'Per-tenant heatmap' panel and set tenant=cobalt. Also check KV-cache timeouts dash: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/kvcache-latency.

alex: For logs, use Loki with this filter: `{tenant="cobalt", status="502"}`. If you want a quick curl: `curl -G "https://logs.redwood/api/v1/query_range" --data-urlencode 'query={tenant="cobalt" status="502"}' --data-urlencode 'limit=50'`

tim: I grabbed three sample request_ids from the logs: request_id=abcd-1234, abcd-2345, abcd-3456. Posted the raw snippets to the incident thread and linked them in this thread.

observability-bot: Generated trace links for the IDs above: https://jaeger.redwood/trace/abcd-1234 , https://jaeger.redwood/trace/abcd-2345 , https://jaeger.redwood/trace/abcd-3456

leah: Suggestion — temporary debounce the prod-ingress 502 alert for tenant=cobalt for 5m while we collect evidence. That should reduce pager churn but keep the metrics flowing. :thinking_face:

alex: Sounds reasonable if scoped to the tenant. I'll open a quick config patch to add a scoped debounce rule: `matchers: tenant=="cobalt"; debounce: 5m; notify: false` — keeps telemetry but suppresses paging.

sara: Thanks — I'll attach the three traces + log snippets to the support ticket and include the Grafana panels. If anyone sees any related 504s or upstream retries, please add notes.

tim: FYI I also saw a couple of upstream 504s in the proxy logs around 23:09:58 — may be related to short retry storms. Check envoy access logs on node proxy-11.

alex: Config PR opened: config-repo#456. Deploy pipeline queued (ETA ~7m). I'll post here when it's live. :white_check_mark:

sara: Great — once debounce lands I'll validate that noise drops and then we can revert or widen scope depending on root cause findings. Thanks all.
